items.title: Frontier model release: run audit-instructions + unhobble over this repo
items.notes: On each frontier model release (primary trigger), run /claude-config:audit-instructions and /claude-config:unhobble over this repository's session surfaces to re-test which standing instructions the new model still needs. The quarterly cadence is a backstop only — the release event, not the date, is the true trigger (docs/PLUGIN-PHILOSOPHY.md, Instruction economy). Session surfaces only, never the shipped plugin components.
